name: Partial Mystical Notes
summary: A strange magical scroll bears symbols you cannot read, yet holds no force you sense as volatile. You take it to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay, where he sees promise in its magic.

sections.title: Unread Symbols
sections.body: You find a magical scroll covered in strange symbols, but the language is beyond you. Its magic feels harmless enough, so you bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay. He recognizes it as potent magic and plans to translate it for his records.

faq.answer: The magical scroll bears strange symbols in a language you do not speak.
You sense no particularly volatile forces within the scroll.
Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay recognizes the scroll's magic and intends to translate it for his records.

faq.q: Where do I bring the partial scroll?
faq.answer: You bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
